question: List the bowlers (including their ID, first name, and last name), match number, game number, handicap score, tournament date, and location for only those bowlers who have won games with a handicap score of 190 or less at all three venues: Thunderbird Lanes, Totem Lanes, and Bolero Lanes. Only include the specific game records where they won with a handicap score of 190 or less at these three locations.
sql: SELECT bs.BowlerID, b.BowlerFirstName, b.BowlerLastName, bs.MatchID, bs.GameNumber, bs.HandiCapScore, t.TourneyDate, t.TourneyLocation FROM Bowler_Scores bs JOIN Match_Games mg ON bs.MatchID = mg.MatchID AND bs.GameNumber = mg.GameNumber JOIN Tourney_Matches tm ON mg.MatchID = tm.MatchID JOIN Tournaments t ON tm.TourneyID = t.TourneyID JOIN Bowlers b ON bs.BowlerID = b.BowlerID WHERE bs.HandiCapScore <= 190 AND bs.WonGame = 1 AND t.TourneyLocation IN ('Thunderbird Lanes', 'Totem Lanes', 'Bolero Lanes') AND bs.BowlerID IN (25, 19, 13) ORDER BY bs.BowlerID, t.TourneyLocation, bs.MatchID, bs.GameNumber
